claims.search: Full 326-atom grammar, depth 4, beam 24, 12000 expanded candidates, 2000000 work per case; baseline/memoized/certified/certified_bound on identical inputs. All pre-expansion operator checks are separately counted and charged. The fourth arm adds safe partial-loss bounds to the third. Seed 2700000 was measured in r2 and is now development; 2800000 is a fresh probe in known generator families, not external generalization.
claims.exploration: All preregistered profiles and all four arms; same perception, skills, memory, actions and budgets. No selecting successful maps after measuring.
claims.curriculum: Matched hypotheses, acquisition and heldout inputs. Include selection, acquisition, update, evaluation and preparation costs; no 90-percent-certainty shortcut.
claims.safety: Incomplete tiers abstain; query outputs never enter actor; native judgments and independent construction oracle remain authoritative. Audits validate receipts, not scientific superiority.
